description: This file defines the MetricVec type and associated methods for managing metric vectors with label currying, hashing, creation, deletion, and matching functionalities within the Prometheus client library.

classes.name: MetricVec
classes.description: A collector that bundles metrics of the same name with different label values, supporting label currying and metric management.

classes.name: metricWithLabelValues
classes.description: A struct holding a metric and its associated label values for collision disambiguation.

classes.name: curriedLabelValue
classes.description: A struct representing a label's index and its curried value.

classes.name: metricMap
classes.description: A helper struct managing the internal map of metrics, with synchronization, hashing, and creation functions.

methods.name: NewMetricVec
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new MetricVec with provided descriptor and metric constructor.

methods.name: DeleteLabelValues
methods.description: Removes a metric matching specific label values.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a metric matching a set of labels.

methods.name: DeletePartialMatch
methods.description: Deletes all metrics containing specified labels, regardless of order.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Implements Collector; describes the metric vector.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Deletes all metrics in the vector.

methods.name: CurryWith
methods.description: Returns a new MetricVec curried with specified labels, reducing cardinality.

methods.name: GetMetricWithLabelValues
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a metric for specific label values.

methods.name: GetMetricWith
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a metric for a label set.
